column2: The good weather has everyone feeling happy!
A wealthy ex-student has decided to gift you a hefty sum of money. Spend it well
The University's sport team just won the National Championship. Everyone's spirits are high and you got some prize money too.
One of your professors published a new study that changes the way we view their subject. Students are flocking to come listen to their lectures.
All of your students passed their exams. Everyone is celebrating!
The miserable weather is affecting everyone's mood.
The roof to a lecture theatre has caved in! You need to pay to fix it and the construction work is unsightly.
The heating in the accomodation buildings has broken down. You were able to get a repair team out quickly so nobody is upset but it cost a lot of money to fix so quickly.
Fresher's flu is spreading again. Many students are too ill to go outside and are bored and lonely in their beds.
Your staff have gone on strike! The students are upset because their essays haven't been marked.
